plan.summary: BRO-5582: 1,618 review files carry wrongProduction=true with no record of why. Stamp a behavior-neutral wrongProductionLegacyAudit field (basis, backfilledBy, backfilledAt) so each flag has an audit trail. No flag value, score or auto-clear behavior changes.
steps: Run backfill-wrongproduction-legacy-audit.js with --apply --expect=1618. It fails the run, writing nothing, unless exactly 1618 trail-less files are found, and fails if any file changes beyond the audit stamp.

actions.description: Stamp the audit field on 1618 legacy wrongProduction flags
